notes: Default four variations according to connected tool and skill; estimate first, audition and select best take(s) rather than upload every variation.

cues.prompt: Quiet empty indoor suburb ambience: fluorescent electrical ballast hum, distant ventilation rumble, enormous enclosed shopping-hall room tone, subtle uneasy air movement. Stable seamless loop, no melody, no voices, no footsteps, no sharp events.
cues.use: A–H normal room ambience; attenuate in A–G outage, retain H.

cues.prompt: Very quiet sealed building darkness: distant building creaks and low hollow air pressure, sparse subtle duct resonance, unsettling vast empty residential atrium. Seamless stable ambient loop, no electrical buzzing, no music, no voices, no jumpscare.
cues.use: A–G blackout only; bounded quiet ambience.

cues.prompt: Close dry muffled human heartbeat, steady slow paired lub-dub pulse at about sixty beats per minute, four even cycles. Subtle organic low thumps with air between, seamless loop, no music, no breath, no voices.
cues.use: Local gaze intensity drives volume and playback speed; silence behind walls/hidden.

cues.prompt: A single quiet precise worn mechanical padlock dial click, muted brass detent, intimate dry sound with a very short natural tail. No music, no voices, no repeated clicks.
Small old mechanical lock refusing a combination: one restrained dull metal clunk and tiny spring rattle, dry short tail. No electronic beep, no music, no voices.
A worn heavy brass padlock opening: clean spring release click, small metal shackle clink, gentle settling rattle. Satisfying but subdued, dry mechanical foley, no music, no voices.

A heavy old interior metal sliding security door opens once: latch release then steady restrained motor grinding and roller scrape, ending in a soft heavy stop. Indoor room reverb, no alarm, no voice, no music.
cues.use: 3D gate opening at all seven boundaries.

cues.prompt: An empty large building losing power over five seconds: staggered fluorescent ballast clicks, sparse electrical sputters moving into a descending ventilation wind-down, ending in near silence. Restrained eerie realistic sound design, no explosive boom, no music, no voices.
cues.use: A–G five-second staggered power collapse only.

cues.prompt: Power returns in a large empty building: quiet breaker relay clack, fluorescent tube ignition ticks then ventilation motor gently winding up to steady low hum. Three second event, no alarm, no music, no voices.
From the far side of a window, two very faint uneven fingernail taps on thin glass followed by a tiny glass resonance. Uncomfortably close but quiet, realistic dry foley, no voice, no music.
cues.use: Sparse localized visible Window Watcher apparition cue, max once/appearance.

cues.prompt: A faint cold slow human exhale heard through closed window glass, distant and muffled, a subtle cloth rustle beneath it, no words, no growls, no screaming, no music.
cues.use: Very low localized tension cue only near visible Watcher.

cues.prompt: A soft uncanny inhaling air movement recedes away behind a window with a delicate dusty fabric rustle, fading into silence. Gentle eerie vanishing sound, no jumpscare impact, no voice, no music.
cues.use: Local disappearance after gaze threshold, once/appearance.
